name: Mitsukake
source:
The healer of Suzaku's warriors. He is soft-spoken and one of the most serious of the Suzaku Celestial Warriors. He was born in Sōen Village, near Chōkō of northern part of Kōnan. His true name is Juan Myō, born the star Chariot (軫). Mitsukake's fighting abilities are limited to his own strength, but as a Celestial Warrior, he possesses incredible healing powers at the cost of exchanging some of his own life force.

Despite his expressionless appearance and tendency to remain silent, Mitsukake is a kind-hearted and calm man who seems aloof, but is actually shy and does not know how to be more outgoing. He is especially kind to the weak, elderly, the sickly, and children, as well as animals.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fushigi_Y%C3%BBgi_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
